# Algeria Compass

> Algeria Compass is a licensed Algerian tour operator running private, expert-guided
> cultural, Sahara, and luxury tours across Algeria, with visa/e-visa support and local
> Algerian guides. We publish independent, fact-checked travel guides on visiting Algeria —
> safety, visas, transport, best time to go, food, and its seven UNESCO World Heritage sites.
> Languages served: Arabic, Tamazight, French, English, Spanish, Italian.
> Contact: https://algeriacompass.com/contact/

## Plan a trip
- [Tours (all itineraries)](https://algeriacompass.com/tours/): Private guided tours — cultural, Sahara, city, and multi-day discovery trips.
- [Luxury travel](https://algeriacompass.com/luxury/): High-end private programs and bespoke Algeria itineraries.
- [Destinations](https://algeriacompass.com/destinations/): In-depth guides to Algeria's flagship places.
- [Regions](https://algeriacompass.com/regions/): Algeria by region — Algiers, Sahara, Kabylie/Béjaïa, Constantine, Tlemcen, M'Zab, Roman east.
- [Experiences](https://algeriacompass.com/experiences/): Ways to travel — desert, culture, history, food.
- [Contact & trip planning](https://algeriacompass.com/contact/): Request a custom itinerary or quote.

## Essential travel guides (independent, fact-checked)
- [Complete Algeria travel guide](https://algeriacompass.com/blog/complete-algeria-travel-guide/): The full overview for first-time visitors.
- [Is Algeria safe? Safety guide](https://algeriacompass.com/blog/algeria-safety-guide/): Honest, current safety guidance for travellers.
- [Algeria visa guide](https://algeriacompass.com/blog/algeria-visa-guide/): Tourist visa and e-visa requirements and process.
- [Best time to visit Algeria](https://algeriacompass.com/blog/best-time-to-visit-algeria/): Season-by-season weather and when to go where.
- [Getting around Algeria (transport)](https://algeriacompass.com/blog/algeria-transportation-guide/): Flights, trains, roads, and desert logistics.
- [Algerian Sahara travel guide](https://algeriacompass.com/blog/algerian-sahara-travel-guide/): Djanet, Tassili n'Ajjer, Timimoun, and desert travel.
- [Algerian food guide](https://algeriacompass.com/blog/algerian-food-guide/): What to eat in Algeria — dishes, sweets, and regional specialities.
- [Algerian handicrafts](https://algeriacompass.com/blog/algerian-handicrafts/): Traditional crafts and what to bring home.
